title: Specified raw class of the restricted chart cone map
statement: For the canonical chart cone leg l and a restricted cohomology class x, construct its canonical inverse-evaluation stage class and pull this back along l with the inverse upperStarComp coefficient identification. The result is an element of the apex raw higher-direct-image presheaf on V. It is a real composite of a uniquely specified inverse isomorphism and the specified raw pullback map, with its defining equation proved; no representative is chosen from mere existence.
